'''Beryl''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the aunt of [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak]] and [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]]. She married the [[Moloch Hoole|brother]] of the [[Shi'ido]] [[Mammon Hoole]].<ref name="GoF:EA" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Beryl was first mentioned in the [[1997]] young reader's novel ''[[Galaxy of Fear: Eaten Alive]]'', by [[John Whitman]].<ref name="GoF:EA" />
